name: Pendalanor
description: Pendalanor was a jungle planet in the galaxy. It took three days of hyperspace to travel from the planet Hoth to Pendalanor. The planet was the home of the Pendalanorians, which were a species of tall, skeletal humanoids. The Ho'Din Ho-Jon lived on Pendalanor.
